messages:
Jordan (AE): Hey team — Acme legal requested our full penetration test package + a remediation timeline by EOD tomorrow. They specifically want the report PDF, verified scan outputs, and a short owner-by-finding timeline. Can we confirm what we can release redacted vs full?
Alex G. (SE): I can bundle the report and the authenticated Nessus export. Need to confirm redaction for internal IPs and customer PII. File names I plan: `redwood-pen-report-2026-05.pdf`, `nessus-auth-export-2026.csv`, `fix-triage-sheet-1767832100.csv`.
Maria S. (Security): High level: OK to share full report with customer as long as we redact cloud account IDs and internal hostnames. Keep raw exploit PoC artifacts internal. We should provide hashes for the files we share. Also include our remediation owners + SLA per finding.
Sam L. (SRE): For the three high/critical findings (CVE-2025-4821, CVE-2026-1102, and missing auth on /admin), we can commit to patching schedule: patch CVE-2025-4821 by 2026-06-02 (owner: Sam L.), CVE-2026-1102 config change by 2026-05-30 (owner: Dev infra team), /admin auth change by 2026-05-28 (owner: Alex G.). I can add staging retest window 2026-06-03 to 2026-06-05.
Jordan (AE): Customer also wants evidence of retest procedure — they asked for the scanning commands and the retest checklist. Is that something we can provide without exposing PoCs?
Maria S. (Security): Provide the scanner configs and command lines (e.g., `nessus -q --scan-id 12345 --policy redwood-standard`) but remove any exploit scripts. Provide checklist steps and retest acceptance criteria (no high findings, <=3 medium).
Alex G. (SE): I'll produce two artifacts: `scanner-configs.txt` (sanitized) and `retest-checklist.md`. I'll include SHA256 hashes: `redwood-pen-report-2026-05.pdf: sha256:abc123...`, `nessus-auth-export-2026.csv: sha256:def456...` (will replace with real sums when packaging).
DevOps Bot: Upload complete: /artifacts/1767832100/redwood-pen-report-2026-05.pdf (size 3.2MB), /artifacts/1767832100/nessus-auth-export-2026.csv (size 1.1MB), /artifacts/1767832100/fix-triage-sheet-1767832100.csv (size 24KB).
Jordan (AE): Nice. For the remediation timeline doc, customer wants owner, ETA, and risk level per finding. Can we use the triage sheet template?
Sam L. (SRE): Yes. I'll update `fix-triage-sheet-1767832100.csv` with owner, ETA, risk, status, and verification steps.
Maria S. (Security): Add a short summary for legal: data handling statement (we redacted account IDs, no customer data in artefacts), and a note: "raw exploit code withheld; available under NDA and signed 3rd-party assessment request."
Jordan (AE): Great. I'll draft the email to Acme and attach the three artifacts + scanner-configs + retest-checklist. Plan: send at 09:00 PT tomorrow.
Alex G. (SE): One ask — customer asked for timeline in calendar-friendly format for their security ops team. I'll export the triage sheet into a simple timeline view (CSV with date, owner, task).
Maria S. (Security): Also include proposed SLA for verification: 5 business days for retest scheduling, 10 business days for remediation confirmation.
Jordan (AE): Thanks. Last thing: can someone confirm there are no outstanding PII or customer-specific logs in the CSV export?
Alex G. (SE): I'll run a grep for e-mail and account patterns and scrub any matches. Command: `grep -Ei "@|account_id|customer_email" nessus-auth-export-2026.csv || true` then manual review.
Sam L. (SRE): I'll take the staging retest scheduling once Alex signals scrubbed files.
Jordan (AE): Perfect. If all goes well we'll send the package + timeline tomorrow morning. I'll post the final email draft here for review before sending. :thumbsup:
Alex G. (SE): Draft incoming in ~1h.
Maria S. (Security): I'll review redactions and legal wording when draft is up.
DevOps Bot: Artifact checksum updated: `redwood-pen-report-2026-05.pdf: sha256:3f8a9b2e7c...`, `nessus-auth-export-2026.csv: sha256:6b41d4c0f...`.
Jordan (AE): Thanks team — synced.
